The original printed face and its wording are retained on this page.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-evacuationcontrol-decipher-archive.gif|Complete original printed face]]; [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Decipher release source].</ref> Released uses November 1996 for that physical printing.
